*Sanidassanattika, Vedanāttika* (Patthana 23.40) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the Paṭṭhāna collection of the Pali Tipiṭaka [SuttaCentral]. As designated by its title, the text examines conditional relations at the intersection of the triad of visible phenomena (*sanidassana-ttika*) and the triad of feeling (*vedanā-ttika*) [SuttaCentral]. No English title or individual modern translation is recorded for this section on SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral].

Computational analysis through DharmaNexus reveals substantial Pali-internal text reuse across the Paṭṭhāna corpus, identifying 202 matching passages distributed across 42 other Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. Its most extensive textual overlaps occur with structurally related combinations involving the *sanidassana* triad, including *Sanidassanattika, Dassanenapahātabbadukādi* (Patthana 22.35; 31 matches, with the longest alignment spanning §1.1_0–2.1_0 ↔ §5.1_0–6.1_0), *Sanidassanattika, Mahantaraduka* (Patthana 22.32; 20 matches), and *Sanidassanattika, Hetusampayuttadukādi* (Patthana 22.28; 9 matches) [DharmaNexus]. It also shares passages with other Paṭṭhāna treatments of the same triad combination, such as *Sanidassanattika, Vedanāttika* (Patthana 17.28) and *Sanidassanattika, Vedanāttikādi* (Patthana 11.17) [DharmaNexus]. No cross-language parallels with Chinese, Tibetan, or Sanskrit texts are registered by DharmaNexus at or above the standard matching threshold [DharmaNexus].
